backup.intro: A PDF backup of the calendar (month overviews) and all events is created automatically every day. You can also create one manually at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Veloprep processes data needed for events, availability, checklists, and customer contact management.
privacy.dataCollected: Data collected: customer contact names, company names, email addresses and phone numbers, as well as employee details and submitted checklists.
privacy.retention: Retention: employee data is kept for the duration of employment; customer contact data while needed for the business relationship. Ask an admin to delete or export it.
privacy.rights: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your data. Contact the admin to exercise these rights.
